entries.name: Monthly budget reset and savings check-in
entries.content: Reviewed January spending, set February category limits, and moved a small amount into emergency savings. Updated notebook with rent, utilities, grocery targets, and shoe replacement timeline.

entries.name: After-work planning talk with Danielle
entries.content: Stayed a little after shift to ask Danielle about what shift supervisors handle beyond customer service, especially inventory counts, labor pacing, and training new hires. Took notes on possible manager certification options.

entries.name: Cold-weather run around Lake Mendota
entries.content: Met Kelsey for an easy morning run despite the cold. Talked about staying consistent through winter and agreed to sign up for a local spring 5K rather than anything expensive or intense.

entries.name: Shared meal prep night at home
entries.content: Cooked a practical weeknight batch meal and portioned lunches for upcoming shifts. Used pantry staples and kept the grocery plan on budget while talking through upcoming bill due dates.

entries.name: Coffee after shift with Emily
entries.content: Grabbed inexpensive coffee after work and talked through a rough lunch rush, schedule changes, and which newer crew members are picking things up quickly. Compared notes on how to keep the line moving during understaffed hours.

entries.name: Roommate apartment check-in
entries.content: Went over shared cleaning tasks, utility split, and a plan to keep the apartment calmer during overlapping workweeks. Mary suggested a simple shared note for supplies to avoid duplicate spending.

entries.name: Family dinner with Lisa
entries.content: Had a casual dinner and caught up on work, winter stress, and family plans for the next couple months. Lisa gave practical advice on staying steady when work gets repetitive and tiring.

entries.name: Farmers market walk and produce shopping
entries.content: Browsed a local indoor market for produce and affordable staples. Kept purchases modest and picked up ingredients for soups and salads for the week.

entries.name: Supervisor skills conversation
entries.content: Asked Danielle if Mary could start helping more with closing counts and training checklists. Danielle outlined areas to improve first: speed under pressure, clearer delegation, and confidence correcting mistakes on shift.

entries.name: Low-key movie night at home
entries.content: Stayed in for a cheap, easy night to decompress after a busy work stretch. Shared snacks, watched a streaming movie, and avoided going out to keep the weekend spending light.

entries.name: Recovery run and race signup
entries.content: Did a shorter recovery run with Kelsey and signed up online afterward for a local spring 5K. Talked about using the race mostly as motivation to stay consistent rather than chase a big time goal.

entries.name: Post-shift snack and vent session
entries.content: Met Emily after closing for a quick, cheap bite. They talked about customer complaints, a register mix-up, and how Danielle handles pressure without letting the whole crew spiral.

entries.name: Household supply run
entries.content: Made a practical stop for paper goods, cleaning supplies, and a few shared groceries. Split costs carefully and stuck to a list to avoid impulse spending.

entries.name: March planning and journal reset
entries.content: Set the month up with shift schedule notes, bill reminders, running days, and savings goals. Wrote a journal entry about wanting more responsibility at work without burning out.

entries.name: Training shadow on closing procedures
entries.content: Danielle let Mary shadow more of the closing routine, including count verification and end-of-night organization. Mary paid close attention to what slows people down and asked a few process questions.

entries.name: Lake path run with Kelsey
entries.content: Ran a moderate morning loop and talked about spring weather, work stress, and whether to do one more local race later in the season. Finished with a quick coffee before work.

entries.name: Early spring gardening prep
entries.content: Cleaned up container beds, checked soil, and talked through what herbs and tomatoes to plant once it warmed up. Kept the plan small and affordable.

entries.name: Casual dinner with Lisa
entries.content: Met for an inexpensive dinner and caught up on family updates, work schedules, and how Mary has been trying to stay disciplined with savings. Lisa encouraged her to keep asking for more responsibility at work.

entries.name: Craft-brew outing with friends
entries.content: Went out for one relaxed brewery stop instead of a bigger night out. Kept spending moderate, split an appetizer, and enjoyed a social break after a demanding week.

entries.name: Community art walk downtown
entries.content: Spent a few hours at a local art walk, mostly browsing and people-watching rather than buying anything. Chose it as an affordable way to get out of the house and do something different.

entries.name: One-on-one career check-in
entries.content: Had a more direct conversation with Danielle about interest in shift supervision. Danielle said Mary is reliable and organized, and suggested focusing next on assertive communication and training confidence.

entries.name: Spring 5K prep run
entries.content: Met Kelsey for a tempo-style run and talked pacing strategy for the upcoming local 5K. Mary mentioned wanting the race to feel fun and structured rather than stressful.

entries.name: Roommate finance and schedule check-in
entries.content: Reviewed April rent timing, utility estimates, and conflicting work schedules. Agreed on a couple easy freezer meals for busy nights and flagged a future need to replace Mary’s work shoes soon.

entries.name: Local spring 5K
entries.content: Ran the local 5K Mary and Kelsey had signed up for earlier in the month. Treated it as a steady personal challenge and social event, then cooled down with coffee afterward.

entries.name: Post-race catch-up after shift
entries.content: Showed Emily the race photo and talked about maybe getting a small group from work to do a fun run later in the year. Conversation drifted back to work schedules and who might be up for more responsibility.

entries.name: Brewers game night
entries.content: Went to a Brewers game as a treat, keeping the outing budget-conscious by planning ahead and limiting extras. Enjoyed the game as a social event more than anything elaborate.

entries.name: Monthly reset: groceries, budget, and week prep
entries.content: Spent part of the afternoon planning meals, checking pantry basics, and doing an end-of-month budget review. Noted that March stayed mostly on track despite the race fee and game ticket.
